name: m3-fix-records
coordination:
Other lanes run at the same time; do not edit their scopes:
- `m3-fix-cleanup` owns src/commands/cleanup.ts, src/commands/land.ts and src/commands/generated.ts.
- `m3-fix-verify` owns src/verify/**, src/commands/verify.ts, src/commands/integration.ts, src/commands/launch.ts, src/config/lane.ts, effectiveRole in src/shepherd/lifecycle.ts, src/cli.ts and scripts/build.mjs.
